definitions.explanation: An accident involving vehicles on a road, including collisions, pedestrian accidents, and other road incidents.

examples.japanese: {交通事故|こうつうじこ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{遭|あ}った→遭う：09500_au⟧。
examples.english: I was in a traffic accident.

examples.japanese: {交通事故|こうつうじこ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{渋滞|じゅうたい}→渋滞：03279_juutai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発生|はっせい}している→発生する：25529_hasseisuru⟧。
examples.english: A traffic jam has occurred due to a traffic accident.

examples.japanese: ⟦{飲酒運転|いんしゅうんてん}→飲酒運転：18486_inshuunten⟧⟦による→による：28349_niyoru⟧{交通事故|こうつうじこ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{絶|た}たない。
examples.english: Traffic accidents caused by drunk driving are never-ending.

notes:
The standard term for any road traffic accident. Frequently appears in news reports and daily conversation. In Japan, even minor fender-benders are typically reported to the police.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {交通事故|こうつうじこ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{遭|あ}う→遭う：09500_au⟧: to be in a traffic accident

- {交通事故|こうつうじこ}⟦{現場|げんば}→現場：02723_genba⟧: accident scene
- {交通事故|こうつうじこ}⟦{証明書|しょうめいしょ}→証明書：09785_shoumeisho⟧: traffic accident certificate
- ⟦{死亡|しぼう}→死亡：03198_shibou⟧{交通事故|こうつうじこ}: fatal traffic accident
